sloka: यत् माम् लोभयसे रंभे काम क्रोध जय एषिणम् ।दश वर्ष सहस्राणि शैली स्थास्यसि दुर्भगे ॥१-६४-१२॥
transliteration: yat mām lobhayase raṁbhe kāma krodha jaya eṣiṇam ।daśa varṣa sahasrāṇi śailī sthāsyasi durbhage ॥1-64-12॥

translations.english: 'O luckless Rambha, since you have endeavoured to distract me from my desire to conquer wrath and passion, you shall turn into a rock and remain so for ten thousand years'.
translations.hindi: तब ठो महर्षि विश्वामित्र जी कुपित हुए और श्रुवा उठा त्रिशंक से यह बोले
